role: 镜2 较劲｜FL2VA｜复用镜1同机位，男伸手碰肩想哄边说台词、女缩肩扭头不应不语、男手停半空收回
prompt:
How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 5.00-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, iPhone handheld footage with realistic skin texture, natural pores, and fine film grain, no plastic or waxy CG look. The same bright warm-white East Asian Chinese living room with the ceiling light on, airy and evenly lit, and the identical sofa framing as Picture 1: the woman at one end hugging a cushion, the man at the far end, a gap of cushion between them. Beginning from the argument-start pose of Picture 1, the man turns his upper body toward her and slowly extends one hand toward her shoulder to make up; the mature East Asian Chinese man in his thirties, half-coaxing and half-anxious at a normal, slightly quick conversational pace (S1), says in sync on camera: <d>[Chinese] 行了别气了，我错了还不行吗？</d> As his hand nears, the woman shrinks that shoulder away and turns her head to the opposite side without a word, refusing the gesture; his hand stops in mid-air and draws back to his knee. The camera holds a nearly static shot with slight handheld drift. The movement lands on the exact positions and composition of Picture 2 at the five-second mark — his hand withdrawn, her head turned away. Both faces stay matte under soft diffused light with no glare or reflection; East Asian Chinese features throughout, no brand or logo anywhere.

overall_soundscape: A quiet living-room tone continues with a faint appliance drone. The reaching arm brushes against fabric and the sofa creaks softly as she pulls her shoulder back.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
prompt_zh: 镜2较劲·FL2VA。复用镜1吵架起点同机位。首帧起点，尾帧=男手收回、女扭头。男侧身伸手碰肩想哄，画内同期口型说(S1)『行了别气了，我错了还不行吗？』→女不应不语、缩肩扭头避开→手停半空收回。语速正常偏快不留死尾。静止微手持，明亮暖白顶灯居家光，哑光真实iPhone感。声景仅居家底噪+伸手布料声/沙发轻响。

checks: state-change action with in-frame synced dialogue: man reaches to coax while speaking (S1) -> woman shrinks shoulder + turns head away in silence -> hand withdraws

soundscape 仅居家底噪+本镜动作声(伸手布料/沙发轻响), 无人声重复; non_diegetic_music N/A
